data.raw_text:
I rated a Grab Driver one star out of 5.
1. He was engaged and actively talking to his buddies on the phone, in loudspeaker, during a group call, amidst the busy traffic of EDSA.
2. Forceful stopping and distracted driving
3. Loud noises.

It was an unpleasant experience
